jd:
Workstream is a mission-driven company building the all-in-one HR, payroll, and hiring platform for managing the hourly workforce. There are 2.7 billion hourly workers, making up 80% of the global workforce, but this market has been heavily underserved by technology and deserves better. Workstream has been purpose-built for the hourly workforce from day one so that these businesses and their employees can thrive.

Our customers include leading brands from multiple sectors, including Burger King, Carl's Jr./Hardee's, IHOP, KFC, and Culvers. We are a high growth series B company and quickly expanding our product portfolio to deliver on our vision. We are backed by legendary VCs and industry experts like Founders Fund, BOND, and Coatue.

We are looking for a dedicated and passionate Software Engineer Co-op to join our Internship program. You should have a background in application development and be able to provide support to our stakeholders and fix bugs. You will also contribute to the development of new software features.

The Co-op Full Stack Software Engineer will report to Vincent Tee and play a key role in scaling our Engineering team.

Day in the Life:



- Own small features end to end, from understanding what the customer actually needs through to the PR and the deploy
- Work with AI coding agents as a normal part of the job - you will be expected to get good at directing them, reviewing what they produce, and spotting when they are wrong
- Investigate and fix bugs customers hit, and write up what caused them
- Join planning and design discussions with product managers and give your own read on what should get built

Who You Are:



- Comfortable in at least one backend language and one frontend framework. We work mainly in Ruby on Rails and TypeScript/React, but we care more that you can pick things up quickly than which stack you arrive with
- You already use AI coding tools in your own work and have a view on where they help and where they do not
- Comfortable with SQL and relational data modelling
- You ask questions when a requirement is vague instead of guessing
- Nice to have: AWS, CI/CD, test-driven development
- Must have excellent communication and problem-solving skills

What We Offer:



- Bubble tea Tuesdays and team lunch Thursdays
- Hybrid working model, Tuesdays and Thursdays are required in office days
- A mission-driven and value-based company dedicated to empower deskless workers and local businesses
- WeWork Office - conveniently located next to Metrotown skytrain comes with amenities and perks including coffee, tea, and kombucha on tap

In compliance with the British Columbia Pay Transparency Act, the base salary for this co-op role is $19 CAD per hour for 37.5 hours per week in British Columbia. For students staying more than one semester (such as 8 or 12 months), the base salary will increase to $22 after the first semester is complete.

Know More About Workstream

- https://techcrunch.com/2021/08/26/workstreams-text-based-recruitment-tool-gets-a-48m-bet-from-bond-and-beyond/

Additional Information

Workstream provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

We are committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals.
